name: Tyrian Companion Bridge
description: Mirrors the loot and price alerts from the Tyrian Companion Obsidian plugin onto a Guild Wars 2 screen notification, and reports your map/character/game-state back to it so it can mark a play session. Bidirectional, authenticated loopback TCP client (protocol v2): paste the plugin's token into this module's settings. Does not call the GW2 API, does not read Mumble Link beyond map/character/gameplay state, does not automate anything in the game.
